levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the four categories is missing from the calendar entirely.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four categories appear on the calendar with a plausible invented recurrence.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The annual renewal is placed thoughtfully rather than arbitrarily, showing awareness that its timing affects clustering.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No specific heaviest month is named, or the smoothing idea is not connected to that month's actual obligations.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A specific heaviest month is named with a workable smoothing idea.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The smoothing idea addresses the root cause of the clustering, not just one symptom of it.

lookFors: All four categories appear at least once on the calendar.
The named heaviest month is actually the one with the most items on the learner's own calendar.
No real bill amount, account, or provider name appears anywhere.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
